retained_textbook_context.locator: Printed page186 / PDF page196, first paragraph under Circulation in the Arabian Sea and Bay of Bengal
retained_textbook_context.seasonal_context: Flow along the western Indian shelf begins as early as November and persists into January; no observed width is assigned to each month.
retained_textbook_context.association_to_proposed_identity: Geographic and winter poleward-flow context, supported by the prepared WICC identity review; the width passage does not explicitly use the WICC name.
retained_textbook_context.relation_to_primary_source: The same paragraph cites Shetye et al.1991 in the forcing discussion. This is contextual synthesis, not an independent width observation or verification of the full primary paper.
retained_textbook_context.confounder: The later 400km-wide wind-stress-curl strip on the same page describes upwelling forcing, not another current-width observation.
retained_textbook_context.redistribution: Original remains locally retained and ignored under its existing acquisition receipt; no new redistribution grant asserted.

interpretation.rule: Keep the two regional statements separate. Their span is not an annual range, a confidence interval, a current-wide width or a basis for interpolated geometry. Vertical current extent is not a width sampling layer.

delivery_requirements.future_visual: Two discrete source-evidence markers with approximate latitude labels, not a map corridor, coastwise interpolation or seasonal envelope; retain unknown errors and exact dates.
delivery_requirements.canonical_integration: After primary full-text and identity gates, batch compatible evidence into the existing query/card/native/WASM delivery cycle. This file alone admits no measurement.
